newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police officer shot dead in ETA attack.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police officer shot dead in ETA attack.

text.p: A Spanish police officer was shot dead on Saturday in what local officials said was an attack by ETA Basque separatist guerrillas.
Local officials said Jose Manuel Garcia, 43, was shot in the head in a restaurant in the northern Basque town of Zierbana and died immediately.
Officials said they did not know the number of attackers, who fled the scene shortly after the shooting.
"This was clearly an attack by ETA due to the nature and target of the attack," said a source at the local government in Vizcaya.
The separatist group has often targeted members of the security forces and police in its 29-year struggle for independence.

Spain's Interior Minister Jaime Mayor Oreja said earlier on Saturday he felt the rebel group was going through a period of decline and the security forces were making progress against the separatists who have killed some 800 people since 1968.

"I believe this year has ...served to make clear that ETA is going through a period of decay, of decline, and without doubt this year they have had numerous failures in what is an attempt to revive this phenomemon in the Basque Country," Oreja told state radio.
"That is why they have become more radicalized in certain circumstances," he said.
